en: The postcard shows a black-and-white image of a grand three-story building with a classical European architectural style. The building features several balconies, large windows, and an arched roofline. Visible signage on the building reads 'SUNDSVALLS TIDNING,' indicating a historic newspaper office. The foreground includes a small park or garden with trees and benches. The reverse side includes handwritten text, a green Swedish postage stamp with a portrait, a postal mark from 'Ljusdal,' and address details in Swedish.
